description.value: Artisan SakeMaker is Canada's original sake winery, operating for two decades on Granville Island and crafting sake from Canadian ingredients shaped by Japanese tradition. Their Sake & Tapas Central tasting room offers OSAKE flights, sake cocktails, and small plates in a relaxed setting steps from the brewing room. The adjoining retail shop carries handcrafted sake, sake kasu products, koji condiments, amazake, Japanese glassware, and gifts — making it a distinctive and unhurried stop on the Granville Island cycling route.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 52m; rack at 54m; rack at 56m; rack at 62m.
